Fed & Policy Watch
  • Monday's verified scheduled items are Treasury bill auctions at 11:30 AM ET and the Board's H.10 at 4:15 PM ET. Auction cutoff times and amounts are from TreasuryDirect; H.10 is shown only on its own Board-listed date.
  • Selected Fed statistical releases include Thursday's H.4.1 at 16:30 ET and Friday's H.8 at 16:15 ET. The Board calendar lists FOMC on October 27-28, outside this Oct 20-23 table.
  • BEA and New York Fed calendars place third-quarter 2026 GDP (advance estimate) on Oct 29 at 8:30 AM ET. New York Fed also lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Oct 29 at 8:30 AM, period unstated; BEA separately schedules Personal Income and Outlays for October 2026 on Dec 2. Kept distinct pending clarification.
  • EIA's petroleum schedule names the Oct 15 adjusted report, already elapsed, and states a usual Wednesday time but has no date-specific petroleum entry for Oct 19-23. The natural-gas schedule gives a usual Thursday time and dated holiday exceptions, but no Oct 19-23 release entry. No EIA event is projected from cadence.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: New York Fed October calendar dates CPI on Oct 14; PPI, Initial Claims and Advance Retail Sales on Oct 15; and Business Leaders Survey, Imports and Exports, G.17 and Staff Nowcast on Oct 16. These elapsed before cutoff and are excluded. CPI and PPI checked as distinct releases; Employment Situation was Oct 2. No elapsed item appears in either calendar table.
  • Checked date-specific primary sources: New York Fed October Economic Indicators Calendar; Federal Reserve Board October calendar and H.4.1 page; Census 2026 calendar; BEA schedule; Chicago Fed data-release calendar and NFCI file; TreasuryDirect auctions; NAR Pending Home Sales release page; Philadelphia Fed survey page; EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedules; and University of Michigan survey page. Selected Board statistical releases only; routine CP and H.15 omitted. Calendar is selected, not exhaustive.
  • NAR confirms Pending Home Sales for September on Oct 20 at 10:00 AM ET. Philadelphia Fed's retrieved survey page did not show an October date; Oct 20 Non-Manufacturing timing is listed by New York Fed and is distinct from Philadelphia's manufacturing survey.
  • Chicago Fed calendar verifies NFCI Oct 21 at 8:30 AM ET (week ending Oct 16) and CFSEC Oct 22 at 10:00 AM ET. Chicago Fed also lists CFNAI on Oct 26, outside this displayed week.
  • Oct 29 Personal Income/PCE timing and period differ between New York Fed (period not stated) and BEA (October 2026 on Dec 2). Reported separately and flagged, not treated as the same period. FOMC Oct 27-28 is outside this week.
  • EIA report dates not explicitly shown for this week are omitted rather than inferred from weekly cadence. No verified unscheduled geopolitical or policy watch item from this run. No exchange product-hours verification was performed; confirm contract, hours, liquidity and event updates before execution.
  • Market quotes are single-source Yahoo observations. SOFR, NFCI and Treasury yields are dated official publications, not live values; sources and observation timing appear above.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Treat the 12:20 AM ET generic ES=F quote as overnight context only. MOVE at 101.10 signals moderate rate uncertainty; latest official 10Y close is 5.09%. Today's 11:30 AM Treasury bill auctions and 4:15 PM H.10 are scheduled checkpoints. Use live yields, volatility and liquidity to assess price discovery; scenario framework only, not a directional forecast or trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES sustains a range break without confirmation from live Treasury yields, volatility and market depth, or if the selected contract's hours differ. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied; reconfirm live quotes, event updates and contract details before execution.
